name: Samba
description: Samba is a rummy card game that involves melding, sets, runs. The game originated in USA/UK and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: Samba is a rummy card game that involves melding, sets, runs. The game originated in USA/UK and has become popular worldwide.

Country/Region of Origin: USA/UK
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4 (partnerships)
Partnerships: With 4 or 6 players, partners sit opposite.
Type: Three standard 52-card decks plus 6 jokers (162 cards total). Twos and jokers are wild.
Three 52-card decks, 6 jokers, score sheet, table space.
Cards per Player: 15 each for 2–5 players; 13 each for 6 players. One card turned face up to start discard pile; remainder forms stock. Dealing clockwise.

items.text: Bolivia: Similar to Samba but allows melds of seven wild cards (bolivia), worth 2500; to go out need two 7-card melds with at least one sequence (escalera).
